securityRuntimeArtifact.boundary: ordivon-security consumes ordivon-runtime Artifact descriptor plus artifact.read
securityRuntimeArtifact.interpretation: Digest equality alone did not prove complete consumption. At EOF the Runtime artifact.read byte offset must equal descriptor retainedBytes.

worldBrowserArtifact.boundary: ordivon-world reconciles Host ArtifactRef, Cloudflare Receipt and downloaded Artifact bytes
worldBrowserArtifact.interpretation: The existing World boundary already protects digest and byte count independently while retaining provider key, media type and Receipt semantics outside byte identity.

decision.reason: A1.2 proved the two-field invariant can expose a real cross-boundary correctness bug, but current consumers need only tiny owner-local checks. A production package would add cross-repository version dependencies without removing lifecycle semantics or owning any state.

reopenGate: Promote only after at least two production consumers repeatedly need the same strict serialized ContentIdentity value across a wire or stored contract, or incompatible local normalization causes another demonstrated cross-project failure.
